geometry.method: Ball Pivoting + local point support and edge filtering

grouping_coordinate_system: Local inference coordinates in meters; add input.inference_origin_m for canonical coordinates
grouping_note: RANSAC + DBSCAN candidates within predicted classes, not learned instances

prediction.adaptations: NumPy voxel averages and SciPy kNN; neural forward graph and weights unchanged
prediction.confidence_note: Maximum softmax score, not calibrated probability of correctness.
prediction.sampling: spatially regular nearest-neighbor crops, original 0.95 EMA voting with bias correction
